switches.label: Estimated session cost
switches.description: Show what the open session has cost so far, priced from recorded usage at the published DeepSeek rates.

switches.label: Account balance
switches.description: Show the remaining account balance in the sidebar foot, above the account row.

switches.label: Open workspace folder
switches.description: Add an “Open workspace folder” row to a Session’s menu that opens its workspace in the file browser.

switches.description: Sign in with the GitHub CLI, browse your repositories, and clone one as a workspace.

switches.label: Add a workspace from this PC or GitHub
switches.description: Put an On this PC / GitHub repository source menu behind the Workspaces + button.

switches.label: Right-panel screenshot
switches.description: Copy the open right panel into the chat as an image, and onto the clipboard.
